harnesses.name: Grok

effort.evidence: grok --help (demo box, 2026-09-01, grok 1.0.13); enum from live invalid-value reject in lead research (xhigh, high, medium, low)

harnesses.models_evidence: unverified 2026-09-04: grok --help (demo box, grok 1.0.13) has -m/--model <MODEL> 'Model ID to use' with no enumeration; `grok models` ('List available models and exit') answers through the leader socket, i.e. the vendor, and Convoy does not call it

harnesses.name: Claude Code

effort.evidence: claude --help (demo box, 2026-09-01) lists low|medium|high|xhigh|max; vendor docs also name ultracode, which is not in --help and is never emitted by Convoy

harnesses.models_evidence: unverified 2026-09-04: claude --help (demo box, 2.1.260) --model <model> takes 'an alias for the latest model ... or a model's full name'; examples, not a closed list

harnesses.models_evidence: unverified 2026-09-04: agy --help (demo box, 1.1.22) --model 'Model for the current CLI session'; `agy models` ('List available models') is a live listing Convoy does not call

harnesses.name: Hermes

harnesses.name: Pi

harnesses.models_evidence: unverified 2026-09-04: pi --help (demo box, 0.80.6) --model <pattern> 'Model pattern or ID (supports provider/id and optional :<thinking>)'; a pattern is not a closed list; --list-models is a live listing Convoy does not call
